description_en: Create a power generation prediction job.

kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-power-forecast-job --device-type solarInverter --history-data RunTime=2025-02-12_00:00:00 Value=1.0 --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --system-type solar --run-date 2025-02-12 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --location Latitude=40.027 Longitude=120.042 Altitude=10.123 --business-key stationA --forecast-horizon DAY_AHEAD --data-mode FULL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePowerForecastJob
